rationale: The stock gapped down ~2.1% on a dilutive equity offering priced at $75/share (below current price of ~$77), creating a natural ceiling near the offering price and suppressing upside. With only 28 minutes to close, price is sitting at 10% of today's range near the session low, well below VWAP ($79.26) and the 9-EMA ($77.21), suggesting persistent selling pressure — but the offering floor near $75 limits clean short downside too. The risk/reward in either direction is unclear with this much noise from the capital raise and insufficient time for a meaningful move to develop.
